books.title: Haunting Adeline
books.author: H. D. Carlton

books.verdict:
Writing Style was good. Zade is every woman's wet dream, Adeline was mid for a bit. I need to re-read this since I was not really paying that much attention when I read it.

rereads.why: They came out with a Graphic Audio.
rereads.comments: I paid closer attention to the book this time around, and I realized Adeline's character was great as well.

books.title: Hunting Adeline
books.author: H. D. Carlton
books.synopsis:
The final installment to the Cat and Mouse Duet...

The Diamond:

They won't keep me forever.
I no longer recognize the person I've become, And I'm fighting to find my way back to the beast who hunts me in the night. They call me a diamond, But they've only created an angel of death.

I was born a predator, With ruthlessness ingrained in my bones. When what's mine is stolen from me in the night, Like a diamond hidden within a fortress,
I find that I can no longer contain the beast. Blood will paint the ground as I tear apart this world to find her. And bring her back to where she belongs. No one will escape my wrath, Especially not those who have betrayed me.
books.verdict:
The first part of the book (which takes up a lot half of the entire book) Was hard to listen to. I had to stop for a bit cause it was too heavy. The abuse and now-con. What got me through was knowing Zade  and Adeline were going to be together in the end

Adeline being out for blood was also a shock. Ending was unsatisfactory. A lot of lose parts of the story too.

books.title: Priest
books.author: Sierra Simone
books.synopsis:
There are many rules a priest can't break. A priest cannot marry. A priest cannot abandon his flock. A priest cannot forsake his God.

I've always been good at following rules.

Until she came. Then I learned new rules.

My name is Tyler Anselm Bell. I'm twenty-nine years old. Six months ago, I broke my vow of celibacy on the altar of my own church, and God help me, I would do it again.

I am a priest and this is my confession.
books.verdict:
Jacob Morgan as Father Bell is HOT!

I can feel the turmoil in his thoughts as he tries to weigh in on his wanks vs. his passion. Asides from the smut, the story lacked depth. There is no character growth FMC, and she is S000 boring.

books.title: Haunting the Hunter
books.author: Hanna Harp
books.synopsis:
Cade Halloway is a hunter, raised by the Order of the Covenantâa cult built on blood, sacrifice, and power. He tracks and eliminates the powerful and corrupt. A predator disguised as a savior, but heâs not here to save the innocent. Heâs here to rip apart the monsters who hide in plain sight. For years, he has been their weapon. Until he discovered the truth...his sister Callisto is slated to be their next offering.

Callisto Halloway was supposed to die for the Order, but her brother has other plans. While in hiding, unable to help or fight, she spends her time trying to control the power she was born with, the power that the Order will kill for. But independence comes at a price, and her uncontrolled power summons a demon far more dangerous than the Order. One that wants more than her body or her soul.

Now, on the run from the Order, Cadeâs only purpose is to save his sister. But Callistoâs power has consequences. Thereâs now an unseen forceâa spectral presenceâfollowing Cade he canât explain and can't escape. A presence that breaks down all of his defenses, and tears down walls even he didnât know he had built, as he finds himself drawn to it in mind, spirit, and body. And it may be the only thing that can save him and Callisto.

You.

Are you sure you want to be haunted?
books.verdict:
I initially thought that since this book was marketed as breaking the fourth wall that "I" was going to he the love interest, but no. That portion of the book was miniscule.

The story revolved around Callisto & Alabaster. Alabaster's narrator was... cringey.

I want to read the next book when it comes out though.

books.title: Den of Vipers
books.author: K. A. Knight
books.synopsis:
They run this town and everyone in it. Their deals are as sordid as their business, and their reputation is enough to bring a grown man to his knees, forcing him to beg for mercy. They are not people you mess with, yet my dad did. The old man ran up a debt with them and then sold me to cover his losses.

Yes, sold me.

They own me now.

Iâm theirs in every sense of the word. But Iâve never been meek and compliant. These men, they look at me with longing. Their scarred, blood-stained hands holding me tight. They want everything I am, everything I have to give, and wonât stop until they get just that. They can own my body, but they will never have my heart.

The Vipers? Iâm going to make them regret the day they took me.

This girl? She bites too.
books.verdict:
Knife play, cheek. Gun play, check.
Twisted characters, check.
Narration was cringe. adjectives were too much. If the writer lessened the adjectives, that would make the book 1/4 shorter. Imagine listening to multiple characters describe a single person over and over again!


last part of the book was just Smut.

books.title: Little Stranger
books.author: Leigh Rivers
books.synopsis:
She betrayed him, and now he wants revenge against the sister who became his forbidden obsession the second he laid eyes on her. After she sends him to prison for years, heâs free and ready to haunt her.

Everything about Olivia belongs to Malachi Vize.
Her mind
Her body
Her soul
Her fear
Her pain

On Halloween night, he can no longer lurk in the shadows. All he has left to own is her heart, even if he needs to take it.
books.verdict:
Malachi was unhinged and mute. 

Olivia was annoying as fuck.

Olivia is a doormat whose trying to please her mom too much and did not give a shit about Malachi. She seems too dense, telling Malachi that they should not be doing things, but still doing them.

The stairs scene though, that scene was *chef's kiss*, when Malachi went lose. 

I would say Olivia deserved it.

books.title: Little Liar
books.author: Leigh Rivers
books.synopsis:
Malachi Vize has always had one desire in life.
One goal. One deep obsession he could never give up on.

His foster sister Olivia.

For the first time, sheâs chosen him over the entire world, and he intends to keep her in his firm grasp forever â but his happiness is soon shattered by powerful enemies who want to claim Olivia for themselves.

He had her.
But then he lost her.

Wounded and still wrestling with his own demons, Malachi is forced into unexpected alliances to hunt them down, but he wonât stop fighting until he gets her back.

No matter what it takes.

This story comes with extremely triggering content. Please read the "Content Warning" page.
books.initial: Where did Joe Arden Go? :( I mean it's not bad... but.
books.verdict:
OLIVIA DOES NOT DESERVE MALACHI!!!

Malachi spirals. The story was too quick paced. I knew their mom was evil, and their dad was the good one.

Olivia doesn't know what she wants to do with her life.

I would re-read this, just for Malachi.

books.title: Torment Part One
books.author: Dylan Page
books.synopsis:
Torment: Part One is a dark, taboo, MC, contemporary romance.

How did I get here? Broken, bruised, and mentally shattered. For most of my life, my older stepbrother, Shay, was my hero, my rock, and my best friend. The one I knew I could always rely on. For many years, I accepted everyone and everything around me. But as I grew up, the veil was lifted, and I slowly came to understand how f*cked up it all really is.

These men, who I considered uncles and close family friends, are members of the dominant MC, The Celtic Beasts. Shay is not only a proud member. He is the one they send in to do their dirty work. For some reason, this tough, muscled, terrifying guy, needs me to ground and comfort him. But I have always had bigger plans. Bigger dreams. I donât want to be trapped here, in this life that is dark, bloody and violent. I want to get out, escapeâ¦ but Shay has other plans for me.

What do you do when your protector becomes the very root of your torment?
books.verdict:
THIS BOOK! Mina and Shay's story, their background, it was *chef's kiss*!

The torment of growing up together was... everything. The snippets of how a Motorcycle Club operates, and how everyone was overprotective of their "ladies"!

Keenan was a side character and I wish the writer focused on him a little more.

books.title: Torment Part Two
books.author: Dylan Page
books.synopsis:
Torment: Part Two is a dark, taboo, MC, contemporary romance.

Shay has given me an ultimatum; be his or someone I love will pay the price. Iâve been trying to figure out how to survive my new life, but the constant demand to satisfy Shay to keep Manic at bay, is taking its toll.

As time passes, I find myself growing comfortable in my cage, and my priorities start to shift. But when secrets start to unveil themselves, I begin to question everyone around me. Who is lying? Who can I trust?

My protector turned into my tormentor, and now, heâs something I donât know how to live without.
books.verdict:
The ending was unsatisfactory. I mean to fight for their love, then to just give up like that. 

After Mina, Keenan, and Shay went through all that. After Keenan tried to save Mina, after Mina tried to protect Keenan, after Shay tried to KEEP Mina, Shay just hands Mina over and kills himself???

books.title: The Wrong Bride
books.author: Catharina Maura
books.synopsis:
Sheâs his fiancÃ©eâs younger sister. Heâs the man sheâs always loved.

When her sister doesnât show up on her wedding day, Raven has no choice but to take her place â but marriage to Ares Windsor is nothing short of torture.

After all, everything is fair in love and war.

books.verdict: Mind numbing. I read this book as a palette cleanser from all the heavy books I've read.

books.title: Lights Out
books.author: Navessa Allen
books.synopsis:
**âI donât need another kink.â**

That thought pops into my head whenever I pull up my favorite social media app, but alas, every time I scroll, I learn something new about myself, and another one is born. And yes, I know Iâm responsible for what the algorithm shows me, but Iâm trying to ignore that fact.

Lately, my feed has been dominated by masked men. Iâve favorited videos with them dressed in full cosplay, decked out in futuristic military apparel, and wrapped up like ghouls.

Lights Out is a fast-paced dark romance with a morally grey male lead. Some themes and scenes may be disturbing to readers. Please check the TWs at the beginning of the book.
books.verdict:
Josh is a hacker and a mask tocker. He's smart.

Alyssa is in love and obsessed with Josh's content. She is a trauma nurse, and a stupid one at that.

I love that Josh is unhinged and dominant, but turns into a stupid puppy in the end of the book. I don't know what the writer was trying to go for here.

books.title: Caught Up
books.author: Navessa Allen
books.synopsis:

Mafia man + a camgirl whose into politics? 

The FMC is mad at someone who has helped her through the years.

I hate the fact that this story is "dick driven" and it lost site of the story midway. The FMC is mad, then the momeent she sees his dicks she's all over the FMC again.

There were no actual pivotal moment. it's all hate, sees dick, fucks, then she's mad and then wants dick, then is in love and is mad again.
books.quote: "Grab her hand in the streets, and her hair in the sheets"

books.title: Unhinged
books.author: Steph Macca

Unhinged is a why-choose dark romance. It contains adult themes, sensitive topics, and is solely intended for mature audiences over 18. It is recommended that listeners check the trigger warnings before diving in. Unhinged is book 1 in the Dance with my Demons series.
books.initial: Corvin King's voice take a while to get used to.
books.verdict:
Theo: 100% in love with his character. He's a quiet protector type.
Grey: Still on the fence with his character.
Avery: A piece of shit. She doesn't know what she she wants, and she's too deep into the self pity hole to even think.
Damon: Is he going to be important character?
books.quote: "I'm your god now, Little Killer, and your Demon too..." -Grey

rereads.comments: When Grey found out about Theo and Avery, I could feel the pain!

books.title: Echoes
books.author: Steph Macca
books.synopsis:

Damon's character is growing on me. 

The Theo, Avery, and Grey ship has sailed, I'm just waiting to see if Damon will going the fun.

Also! THAT KISS! That shut up kiss!
books.quote: I can't watch you be with someone else, Little Killer. It makes me want to kill him. The only reason he is still alive is because of you. -Grey

rereads.comments: Corving King might be a favorite at this point now too.

books.title: Ravage
books.author: Steph Macca
books.synopsis:

books.verdict:
Damon finally gave in! I've been waiting for this!

This book has a lot of twists and turns and I cannot Seem To wrap my head around the fact that all three men love Avery.
It's so good to finally see the FML growing a spine and embracing who she is.

THE HIDDEN MARRIAGE & Fuck you to Damon's dad though!
books.quote: It appears we are all playing dangerous games, but that's the thing about games, for every winner, there has to be a loser.

rereads.comments: I stopped at book three because I still remember book 4. I paid more attention to Damon this time around.

books.title: Exile
books.author: Steph Macca
books.synopsis:

In death, we thrive.



Exile is a why choose asylum secret society dark romance. It is book 4 in the Dance With My Demons series and cannot be read as a standalone. books.verdict:
Lilydale closed out, each person in the asylum is getting tried for their crimes again. The distance between Avery and the men was excruciating, but at least it made her GROW.

This book had the perfect ending. 

Although I think four books is too long for this series, it could have been written as a duet, the writer must've been in a rush to publish each book.

books.title: I Will Break You

books.verdict:

Can't wait to start book two to see if someone will finally find out the abuse each character seems to have.

books.title: Voracious

The cliff hanger at the end is killing me.

I need the next book asAP.

This book has made me feel things, and the way it is written tugs at my heart strings. The character development for Chis is awesome too.
books.quote: Save him, save her, save them.

books.title: Restitution
books.author: Leigh Rivers
books.synopsis:
THE WEAPON THEY CREATED
WILL BE THEIR DESTRUCTION

The line between sense and madness blurs as Kade seeks revenge on those who destroyed his life. They threatened his family, shattered his sanity, and then they stole his girl. Heâll sacrifice everything to save them all, even if it means war.

Stacey Rhodes has been to hell and back, and now sheâs trapped by the monster who stole Kade from her. But Stacey isnât backing down â sheâll do anything it takes to save Kade, no matter the cost.

books.verdict:
The ending was so good! The number of deaths or almost deaths in this book, I don't think I could handle. I couldn't breathe.

Maybe part of my top books!

books.title: God of Malice

books.verdict:
Overall story is great. I knew my "best friend " was still alive!

A little bit of a slow burn, but thats alright.

Killian "Kill' is an awesome name.

FMC is also okay.
I wished there was more focus on the clubs/secret societies, though.

books.title: Under Your Scars

books.synopsis:
According to the FBI, I was considered a serial murderer after three kills.

What do they call me after fifty-two?

They call me the Silencer.

One final bullet would have been all it took to stop me from taking another soul, and I would have been doing Meridian City a service by pulling that trigger.

An angel crying for help stopped me, and that night, I took three lives for her. Then three turned into eight. Then eight turned into twenty. Twenty turned into twenty-one. Twenty one turned into twenty-three.

books.verdict:
How do I start this? Initially I saw the reviews of this book and it promised a roller coaster ride, and it fucking was.

I initially  had a doubt that Christian was the Silencer, until like mid way in the book.

I always kept looking if the book was about to end, but this book is long long, all bases covered. I always though that when something happened and it gets resolved, the book is about to end!

This book I would have to say is my favorite. If only I could unread a book to forget it and re-read it all over again, I would do that with this book.

The ending killed me.

books.title: The Temporary Wife

books.verdict:
I used this book as a palette cleanser from Under Your Scars.

Nothing really special except for Joe Arden's voice.

books.title: Mine

books.synopsis:
I always knew my father was a cold, heartless bastard.

I didn’t care they lost their home. Didn’t care their father was behind bars.

books.verdict:
Shelved as DNF.

I tried to finish the book, but the main female lead was spineless.

Literally this book was poorly written, no story, it had a little, then all gone.

It felt like I was reading a book written by a 10 year old.
Inconsistency was key.

The FMC is all like: I fell for him, then I hate him, then I want him, then I'm scared of him, over and over.

The FMC also foes from being head strong to being weeks to being fuck drunk.

books.title: Lilac
books.author: B. B. Reid
books.synopsis:
I, Braxton Fawn, am the luckiest girl alive.

Or so the world keeps telling me. Every so often, gods walk the earth. This time they came as musicians. When Bound loses its lead guitarist, yours truly is chosen to fill his shoes. From dive bars to the big stage, my instant claim to fame is nothing short of a fairytale. The only problem? My new bandmates.

Jaded, gorgeous, and ridiculously talented—they're determined to turn my dream into a nightmare. It's no secret I wasn't their first choice. I wasn't even their last. The label wants a new image, Bound wants me gone, but I've got my own agenda. To succeed I have to survive a world tour, public scrutiny, and idols turned enemies. But the biggest threat of all isn't a meticulous frontman, a narcissistic bassist, and a drummer with too many secrets.

It's me.

Somehow, I must resist the temptation of Houston Morrow, Loren James, and Jericho Noble. It seemed easy enough when I boarded their tour bus, but it only took one city for the lines we'd drawn to blur.

Only ninety-nine more to go.
books.verdict:
The story dragged on a bit longer than I would like, I got bored midway.

It would have been nice if Teddy Hamilton's character had more chapters, he felt more like a side character than the main lead of the band.

I didn't like to voice of the female narrator.

Braxton and all the characters were well written.

The way Braxton found out about Rich's wife though, was a little underwhelming, given that there was so much build up about it.

Lauren and Houston's backstory felt like an after thought, and it didn't need to be part of the story.

Braxton's synthesia played a big role, kind of weird that it was removed at the end.

books.title: Corrupt Idol
books.author: Dinah Harper
books.verdict:
Violet & Jessie's love was violent and volatile. 

The book, I believe was too short to cover every aspect of their relationship. It seems like ti was published to soon, and it ended too soon.

There seems to be no updates on when the second book is coming out.

books.title: Love Me to Death
books.author: Brynne Asher
books.synopsis:
'm driven by an obsession for a man who's turning out to be dark, dangerous, and downright depraved.

It all started with an auction. I couldn't help myself. There was no way I was going to allow another woman to win a date with the broody firefighter who fascinated me from the beginning. I paid a ridiculous amount of money that I couldn't afford for one night with him, but when my instincts took over, there was no going back.

Brand Vitale might look like a hero to the rest of the world, but looks can be deceiving. He's no typical hero. But then again, I'm no fairy tale princess. Even if I did lose a shoe.

Brand barged into my life, took me by the hand, and led me straight into a world of secrets, rival mafia families, and murder. I didn't just follow him. I jumped.

And it turns out, my obsession is nothing compared to his burning desire to make me his. Because with a passion this deep, you have no option but to love... straight to death.
books.verdict:
Initially, the story was intriguing.

But as the story progressed, it started to make less and less sense.

This book tried so hard to be a dark romance, and a mafia book, but it failed miserably.

They were trying to absolve the MMC from killing the wife, and the FMC acted so innocent, and the way she was written made it seem like she does not know what it going on.

Only to find out SHE killed his wife?

I tapped out after that, since knowing she killed his wife, and the FMC's innocence in the first half of the book no longer made sense.

books.title: Butcher & Blackbird
books.author: Brynne Weaver
books.synopsis:
Every serial killer needs a friend.
Every game must have a winner.

When a chance encounter sparks an unlikely bond between rival murderers Sloane and Rowan, the two find something elusive—the friendship of a like-minded, pitch-black soul. From small town West Virginia to upscale California, from downtown Boston to rural Texas, the two hunters collide in an annual game of blood and suffering, one that pits them against the most dangerous monsters in the country. But as their friendship develops into something more, the restless ghosts left in their wake are only a few steps behind, ready to claim more than just their newfound love. Can Rowan and Sloane dig themselves out of a game of graves? Or have they finally met their match?

Butcher & Blackbird is the first book in the Ruinous Love Dark Romance trilogy of interconnected stand-alone dark romantic comedies. This dual POV novel ends on a HEA.
books.initial: Joe Arden's Irish Accent! MY GOD!
books.verdict:
The book was funny, although it took quite a while to finish it.

The main reason I chose this book was because of Joe Arden and I wasn't disappointed.

I loved their games, and the way the story was written.
